skytower.name: Sky Tower
skytower.price_text: ≈ NZD 40–45 adult observation deck; child rates lower (check on the day)
skytower.tip: Go up about an hour before sunset to see the city in daylight and lit up.

museum.name: Auckland War Memorial Museum
museum.price_text: ≈ NZD 25–30 adult for non-residents; Auckland residents free (check on the day)
museum.tip: Allow at least two hours. The Maori and Pacific galleries are the highlight.

viaduct.name: Viaduct Harbour
viaduct.hours: Always open; bars and restaurants run late
viaduct.tip: Walk the waterfront at dusk, then pick a table for dinner.

harbourbridge.name: Auckland Harbour Bridge
harbourbridge.price_text: Free to view; bridge climb and bungy cost extra (check on the day)
harbourbridge.tip: Best seen from the Northcote or Bayswater side, or from a harbour ferry.

waiheke.name: Waiheke Island
waiheke.price_text: ≈ NZD 40–55 return ferry; wine tours and tastings extra
waiheke.hours: Ferries run through the day; last boat back in the evening (check on the day)
waiheke.tip: Book the ferry and a wine tour ahead in summer. A full day is barely enough.

piha.name: Piha Beach
piha.price_text: Free; car or tour needed to get there
piha.hours: Always open; swim only between the flags
piha.tip: Strong surf and currents. Swim between the flags and skip the west coast in rough weather.

adventurepark.name: Auckland Adventure Park
adventurepark.price_text: Varies by activity; check on the day
adventurepark.tip: Confirm opening hours and booking before you travel out.

crystalmountain.name: Crystal Mountain
crystalmountain.tip: It is outside the city centre, so plan transport before you go.

lionbrewery.name: Lion Brewery
lionbrewery.price_text: Tour prices vary; check on the day
lionbrewery.tip: Book ahead and confirm tours are running before you go.

rainbowsend.name: Rainbow's End
rainbowsend.price_text: ≈ NZD 55–65 day pass; child rates lower (check on the day)
rainbowsend.hours: Usually Wed–Sun, roughly 10:00–17:00 (check on the day)
rainbowsend.tip: A half-day out for families. Check the ride schedule before you go.

civic.name: The Civic Theatre
civic.tip: Look up at the Moorish ceiling in the main auditorium.

university.name: University of Auckland
university.tip: Wander the old brick buildings and the Albert Park edge nearby.

fishmarket.name: Auckland Fish Market
fishmarket.price_text: Free to enter; food priced per item
fishmarket.hours: Roughly daily daytime to early evening (check on the day)
fishmarket.tip: Come hungry for fresh seafood and casual eats by the water.

mteden.name: Mount Eden summit
mteden.tip: A short climb gives the best free city and harbour view. Go early or at sunset.

ponsonby.name: Ponsonby Road walk
ponsonby.price_text: Free to walk; cafes and shops extra
ponsonby.hours: Shops daytime; bars into the evening
ponsonby.tip: Walk the strip for cafes, boutiques and old villas. Stop for brunch.

ferry.name: Auckland harbour ferry
ferry.price_text: ≈ NZD 10–20 per crossing depending on destination (check on the day)
ferry.tip: A short ferry to Devonport is a cheap harbour cruise and a nice half-day.

britomart.name: Britomart precinct
britomart.price_text: Free to wander; food and drink extra
britomart.hours: Cafes daytime; restaurants and bars into the evening
britomart.tip: Good base for coffee, lunch and evening drinks near the waterfront.

albertpark.name: Albert Park
albertpark.tip: A quiet green stop between the museum and the city centre.
